svg.title: The evidence gate
svg.desc: A test walks every registered visualization, and a trace step with no source that resolves fails the suite. Steps: 1. A test walks every registered visualization. 2. Each trace step must name a source. 3. Each source must resolve in the sources file. 4. A step with no source fails the build. Sources: Algorithm Visualizer README.

text.tspan: A test walks every registered visualization.
Each trace step must name a source.
Each source must resolve in the sources file.
A step with no source fails the build.
